function.name: inspect
function.description: Dump the current desktop accessibility tree (AT-SPI / UIA / AX) and timing metrics. Prefer this to a screenshot when you need element ids, roles, names, and bounds.

force.description: Force a full rescan instead of the incremental cache.

function.name: map
function.description: Dump the classified element location map (name/role/region -> screen coordinates).

refresh.description: Refresh from a new snapshot first.

function.name: act
function.description: Run one scripted desktop action without an LLM. Tools: click, type, shortcut, scroll, move, app, shell, wait, inspect, file, screenshot, done. Default policy is HYBRID.

tool.description: Action name, e.g. click, type, shortcut.

function.name: run
function.description: Run a plain-English desktop task with an OpenAI-compatible LLM. Requires LINUX_USE_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY.

function.name: windows
function.description: List top-level windows (id, title, geometry, pid, active).
